target_customer: Knowledge workers who take meeting notes in Notion or Google Docs
problem: After meetings people must manually turn notes into emails, calendar invites, tickets and reminders. Sidenote's Chrome extension detected action items in notes and completed them.
business_model: Chrome extension productivity tool, pricing not found

founders.name: Jason Lin
education: Stanford, computer science with a human computer interaction focus
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led a team that built the US's first vaccination tracker.

founders.name: Scott Hickmann
education: Stanford, electrical engineering and computer science
founders.background_notes: YC page mentions a viral motorized couch, Robosub and Chirpy Cardinal at the Stanford AI Lab.

founders.name: Schwinn Saereesitthipitak
founders.background_notes: YC page lists deep learning research at the Stanford AI Laboratory and NVIDIA and earlier cryptography research at Stanford EE.

competitors.name: timeOS
competitors.what: Chrome extension that puts meeting details in one place

technical_complexity.rationale: An LLM based extension that parses notes and calls calendar, email and ticket APIs was within reach of a small team in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: Many note taking and meeting tools were adding the same follow up actions, and the extension had no data or network advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Meeting assistants and workspace vendors broadly added AI summaries and action items. No acquisition of Sidenote was found.

market_need_then: Meeting overload and follow up work was a common complaint and AI note tools were gaining attention in mid 2023. No Sidenote usage figures were found beyond a Product Hunt launch on 2023-07-22.

branding.domain_note: Uses sidenote.ai, which now shows a compliance coaching product.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain productivity language: meeting follow-up, automated

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive and friendly name that suits a notes tool, but the word is generic and shared with other products. No brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Sidenote was a Stanford founded three person team that launched a meeting follow up Chrome extension in July 2023 and raised only the standard YC amount, according to aggregators. YC marks it inactive, but the current sidenote.ai site sells a compliance coaching product, so the company may have changed direction or the domain may have changed hands. No source explains what happened, so no cause of failure is recorded.
notes: YC lists no website, so sidenote.ai was fetched and shows a different, compliance coaching product with a 2026 copyright, which may be a pivot or a different owner. The $500K round rests on aggregators: CB Insights calls it a convertible note dated 2023-06-09, VCBacked calls it pre-seed in July 2023, Dealroom lists $500k and a separate $125k seed entry. Exit type is unknown because of the site conflict. Founders also appear on a second YC page named ube, not examined.
